hook_line: MICROSOFT EARNINGS BEAT ESTIMATES AS REVENUE RISES 19% TO $92.3 BILLION AND AZURE JUMPS 48%

hook_stat.sub: Microsoft revenue in the fiscal first quarter, up 19%

stats.label: Rise in Azure revenue to $33.17 billion
Adjusted earnings per share, ahead of $4.73 expected

diaspora_bullets: Free cash flow was $18.6 billion despite $45.2 billion of capital spending
Microsoft returned $10.2 billion to shareholders in the quarter
news_summary: Microsoft reported revenue of $92.3 billion for the quarter ended September 30, up 19% from a year earlier, with operating income up 21% to $45.9 billion.
payoff: Microsoft guided to second-quarter revenue of $96 billion to $97.1 billion.
